items.source: spec to declare the expected response
producer - the source of payload data value(s). This must be a Publisher or another producer adaptable to a Publisher via ReactiveAdapterRegistry
items.translation: `producer` - 负载数据值的来源。这必须是一个 `Publisher` 或通过 ReactiveAdapterRegistry 适配为 `Publisher` 的其他生产者。

items.source:
Provide payload data for the request. This can be one of:
  • Concrete value
  • Publisher of value(s)
  • Any other producer of value(s) that can be adapted to a Publisher via ReactiveAdapterRegistry
items.translation:
提供请求的负载数据。可以是以下之一：
  • 具体值
  • Publisher 类型的值
  • 任何可以通过 ReactiveAdapterRegistry 适配为 Publisher 的其他值生产者

items.source: Variant of data(Object, Class) for when the type hint has to have a generic type. See ParameterizedTypeReference.
items.translation: `data(Object, Class)` 的变体，用于类型提示必须具有泛型类型的情况。请参阅 `ParameterizedTypeReference`。

items.source: Variant of data(Object) that also accepts a hint for the types of values that will be produced. The class hint is used to find a compatible Encoder once, up front vs per value.
items.translation: `data(Object)` 的变体，它还接受一个提示，指明将要生成的值的类型。类提示用于一次性（在开始时）查找兼容的 `Encoder`，而不是针对每个值进行查找。

items.source: Variant of data(Object) that also accepts a hint for the types of values that will be produced.
items.translation: 接受用于提示将要生成的值类型的提示的 `data(Object)` 变体。

items.source: Variant of data(Object, Class) for when the type hint has to have a generic type.
items.translation: 适用于类型提示必须具有泛型类型的 `data(Object, Class)` 变体。

items.source: Append additional metadata entries through a Consumer. This enables libraries such as Spring Security to provide shortcuts for applying a set of customizations.
items.translation: 通过 `Consumer` 追加额外的元数据条目。这使得 Spring Security 等库能够提供应用一组自定义配置的快捷方式。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if not using composite metadata.
items.translation: `IllegalArgumentException` - 如果不使用组合元数据。

items.source: data - the Object value for the payload data
items.translation: data - 有效负载数据的 Object 值

items.source: elementClass - the type of values to be produced
elementTypeRef - the type of values to be produced
Append additional metadata entries through a Consumer.
items.translation: 通过 `Consumer` 追加额外的元数据条目。

items.translation: 用于声明 RSocket 请求输入的规范。
